Hardford CNC Equipment Co., Ltd.

Hardford specializes in the manufacturing, sales and service of CNC machine tools. 40 years of CNC machine manufacturing experience and a 40-acre modern production facility.

Imported high-precision master machines enable us to improve manufacturing precision from the very source. We implement strict quality control at every stage to guarantee machining accuracy and operational stability.

We have applied for over 30 patents and certifications. Our products are exported to 56 countries and regions worldwide.
